Engine images (issue #98, plain make, no LLM):
  make generate-engine-params      skills -> containers/engines/{params,dockerfiles,base} (the ONLY step that reads skills)
  make sync-quant-catalog          regenerate data/trending-quant-catalog.json + fixture (the HF class table: model -> engine -> arch + real quant plans), from the registry + live Hub; validates the newly-added links vs the prior generated table
  make check-quant-catalog         CI: fail if the committed quant catalog differs from what the generator produces
  make render-trend-list-matrix    rewrite tests/fixtures/trend-list-matrix.json (the trending list per arch, vram, ram)
  make check-trend-list-matrix     CI: fail if that committed list differs from matrix() on the vendored registry
  make render-engine-skill-gap     rewrite data/engine-skill-gap.json (per-engine list + the models no engine can offer)
  make check-engine-skill-gap      CI gate: a registry engine with no skill and no dated decision in data/unsupported-engines.json, a stale decision, or a stale file
  make engine-skill-gap            show the gap: shipped / known-unsupported / NEW-unresolved engines
  make spawn-engine-skill-issues   open one tracking issue per NEW unskilled engine (the weekly sync runs this)
  make registry-change-report      print what the vendored registry changed vs HEAD
  make sync-change-issue           open ONE issue stating the change (the weekly sync runs this)
  make check-wiring                CI: fail when a test/script is wired to no make target, or only to one CI never runs (tests/fixtures/host-only-wiring.json records the deliberate ones), or when a .PHONY entry names no target or a target that runs nothing
  make check-secret-output         CI: fail when any file prints a secret's VALUE (an echo of a token variable), passes it on a command line (a value after -e), runs under a shell xtrace, dumps the environment around it, or commits a credential-shaped literal
  make wiring-report               show how every test/script is wired (target + whether CI runs it) and the host-only exceptions
  make issue-bot-dispatch          the issue-implementer dispatcher (issue #248): cap 3/day -> pick one labeled/ready issue -> claim -> write issue.md + branch
  make issue-bot-open-pr          open the draft-free PR linking ISSUE from BRANCH (never merges)
  make issue-bot-gates            re-check the FAST gates in order before the bot pushes (lint, workflows, wiring, docs, PR hygiene, OpenSpec tasks), stopping at the first failure and naming it (issue #475)
  make issue-bot-gates-check      CI: fail when a ci-unit gate is classified nowhere, a fast gate is unwired, or the bot's gate step is not between the detection and the push (issue #475)
  make lane-preflight             run the FAST gates before a host lane pushes: one line per gate, a final OK|FAILED verdict, refuses a dirty tree so the verdict describes the would-be-pushed head (issue #1058)
  make code-review-scan           the code-review bot: read the tree + the pipelines -> findings (REPO=; STATIC=1 skips the checks that read the GitHub API; no model spend, files nothing)
  make code-review-file           file ONE issue per NEW finding, capped per run (REPO=; CAP= per run, default 3; DRY=1 previews) — the bot's whole output is issues
  make run-failure-reactor        route a failed CI run to a remedy (REPO=; RUN_ID=; DRY=1 previews): a pushable same-repo PR -> dispatch the fix-bot; else file ONE deduped issue labelled agent:implement (issue #286)
  make implement-issue             the shared Hermes agent step: read issue.md + AGENTS.md, implement, run the gates, push nothing (NOUS_API_KEY from a secret)
  make hermes-smoke               one real Hermes call through the implementer alias (die in seconds)
  make agent-jev-preflight           report whether the JEV decision layer is available in the agent image (never blocks a run; NERVE_REQUIRE=1 verifies the image instead) — issue #238
  make check-docs                  CI: fail when a user-facing make target is undocumented, an exception is stale, an agent-wiki/ note is not indexed in CHANGES.md, or README.md carries change history
  make docs-report                 show every user-facing make target (documented / missing / recorded exception) and each work record's issue references
  make check-pr-authors            CI: fail when a PR commit is authored through an allowlisted email address, when a Co-authored-by trailer names anyone else, or when a producer commits off the allowlist — PR_BASE/PR_HEAD bound the range (issue #345)
  make pr-authors-report           show every commit in the range with its author verdict, and the identity each producer assigns
  make build-engine ENGINE=<id> [ARCH=cpu|cuda|rocm|vulkan] [PUSH=1]   build from the generated Dockerfile
  make build-engine-<id>-<arch>    e.g. build-engine-vllm-cuda, build-engine-llama.cpp-prism-rocm
  make build-engines ARCH=<arch>   every engine for one arch
  make run-engine ENGINE=<id> MODEL=<m> [PORT=11434]   OpenAI API at http://127.0.0.1:PORT/v1 (llm-local)
  make list-engine-images | ci-engine-images [WATCH=1]

Targets: install (venv+launcher+symlink+smoke), venv-install, link, smoke,
         test-unit, test-install, test-health (endpoint answers 'hi'), test,
         download-test-model, openspec-validate, openspec-new/status,
         loop (chained runner), loop-harness, chained, uninstall,

Daily sync (issue #107):
  make engine-bump-plan [ENGINE=<id>]   which engines moved upstream (git ls-remote only)
  make engine-derive ENGINE=<id> [SHA=] derive build params from the upstream tree (no LLM)
  make engine-bump ENGINE=<id>          pin + derive + apply + regen (no push)
  make engine-bump-daily [DRY=1]        plan -> bump every moved engine; DRY=1 prints only

Install (issue #98: engines run from their images):
  make install [ENGINES=all|id,id] [ARCH=cpu|cuda|rocm|vulkan] [BUILD=1]   pull this host's tested images + start scripts + version test
  make install-prism-cpu|upstream-cpu|prism-cuda|upstream-cuda   one llama.cpp tree + backend (image)
  make install-prism-metal|upstream-metal                         macOS: native Metal build
  make build-variant TREE=prism|upstream BACKEND=metal            native build (Metal / macOS CI)
  llgenie --pick [model] [--engine e] [--model-file f] [--auto]   pick model + fastest engine image

Env seams (override detection):
  LLAMA_SERVER_TREE=prism|upstream   force the llama.cpp tree (else card RAM: <=24GB prism, >24GB upstream)
  LLAMA_BACKEND=cpu|cuda|metal       force the backend (else hardware: Metal/CUDA/CPU)
  LLAMA_RAM_BYTES=<bytes>            force the card RAM used by the tree decision
  SERVER_ROOT=<dir>                  where llama.cpp trees are cloned (default ~/repository/git)
